summary: Tested Statistics/Analytics page feature for Clara radio management app. All 5 backend API endpoints pass tests with proper response structure and authorization. Frontend Statistics page loads correctly with all charts (AreaChart, BarChart, PieChart), KPI cards, per-WP-site stats, category breakdown, and top authors table. Export PDF and navigation buttons present.

backend_api_tests.monthly_endpoint: PASS - Returns 12-month breakdown with created, published, scheduled counts
backend_api_tests.top_authors_endpoint: PASS - Returns ranked list with total_items, approved, pending, rejected, published_to_wp
backend_api_tests.per_site_monthly_endpoint: PASS - Returns per-WP-site monthly publishing data with site_names array
backend_api_tests.weekly_activity_endpoint: PASS - Returns weekly content creation activity with items_created
backend_api_tests.authorization_unauthenticated: PASS - All endpoints return 401 for unauthenticated requests

frontend_statistics_page.kpi_cards: PASS - Total Articles (173), Published (172), Scheduled (0), Failed (0)
frontend_statistics_page.monthly_trend_chart: PASS - AreaChart with Created/Published/Scheduled lines for 12 months
frontend_statistics_page.per_site_bar_chart: PASS - Stacked BarChart with GRK and MFY data per month
frontend_statistics_page.weekly_activity_chart: PASS - BarChart showing weekly content activity
frontend_statistics_page.category_stats: PASS - Horizontal bars showing content per category
frontend_statistics_page.top_authors_table: PASS - Table with author rankings (Yannick Gijbels: 131, System Administrator: 41, Hadewig Weyen: 1)
